popupProfileRequired: Recording needs at least one profile. Restore the recommended profiles or import yours in Options.
popupProfileCancelRuleChanged: It recorded with {started}, but the site rules pick {next} for this page.
popupProfileCancelRuleChangedFix: To keep recording here with {started}, add a site rule for this site or make it the default profile in Options → Profiles.
popupProfileCancelMissing: The profile {started} was deleted while recording.
popupProfileCancelMissingFix: Choose another profile, or create or restore one in Options → Profiles, then start again.
popupProfileCancelEdited: The profile {started} was changed while recording.
popupProfileCancelEditedFix: Start a new recording to record with the new settings.
popupProfileCancelPolicy: Your organization's policy changed what {started} may record.
popupProfileCancelPolicyFix: Start a new recording. Ask your administrator if you need more data.
popupProfileCancelKept: What was recorded before the change is kept: export or delete it.
popupExportPassphraseBody: Archives are always encrypted (AES-GCM). Enter a passphrase of at least 8 characters: you need it to open the archive. It is remembered until the browser closes, so later exports do not ask.
popupPassphraseRequired: Enter a passphrase of at least 8 characters: archives are always encrypted.
popupExportTimedOut: Export did not finish within 2 minutes. Check Chrome downloads or reload the extension and retry.
popupExportPrivacyWarningAlert: Export completed, but the privacy scanner found {count} possible sensitive item(s): {summary}. Review the archive before sharing.
popupReloadTitle: Reload the Page When Recording Starts?
popupReloadBody: Recording starts first, then the page reloads, so the session captures its load from scratch: the first network requests, scripts (for source maps), and early console messages and errors. Unsaved changes on the page may be lost.
popupDisconnected: Lost the connection to the extension. Close and reopen the popup.
popupInterruptedHint: Ended without Stop when the extension restarted. What was saved before that is kept and can be exported.
popupReloadRemember: Don't ask again (change it in Settings)
popupExportStepBody: Save the encrypted archive to attach it to the bug report. If you do it later, the recording waits on the sessions page until you export or delete it (until the browser closes).
popupPassphraseAsked: The export asks for a passphrase once; it is remembered until the browser closes.
popupPassphraseRemembered: Passphrase remembered until the browser closes
popupPassphraseForgotten: Passphrase forgotten: the next export asks for it.
popupFallbackTitle: Full capture stopped — recording continues in Light
popupFallbackRestrictedPage: This page does not allow the debugger (browser pages, the Chrome Web Store, other extensions).
popupFallbackAttachFailed: The debugger could not attach to the tab (another debugger or DevTools may hold it).
popupFallbackCanceledByUser: “Cancel” was pressed on Chrome's “started debugging this browser” bar.
popupFallbackTargetClosed: The debugged page went away while the tab stayed open.
popupFallbackDetached: Chrome detached the debugger from the tab.
popupFallbackLost: No longer captured: response bodies, full console with stacks, screenshots and DevTools network data. Page-side capture goes on; the archive records when and why.
